supplements.title: BCL-2 Mediated Apoptotic Pathway as Promising Target for Bio- Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles: A Review Article.
supplements.summary: Bio-synthesized silver nanoparticles trigger cancer cell death by activating the BCL-2 apoptotic pathway across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: N-acetylcysteine nano-spray versus conventional treatment in the management of radiotherapy-induced oral mucositis in oral cancer patients: a randomized clinical trial.
supplements.summary: N-acetylcysteine nano-spray reduced radiation-induced mouth sores better than standard treatment in oral cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy.

supplements.title: Combination of Tripterygium glycosides and Lactobacillus paracasei sensitises epithelial ovarian cancer to cisplatin via downregulating Keap1-Nrf2-GPX4 signalling pathway.
supplements.summary: A plant extract combined with beneficial bacteria makes ovarian cancer more responsive to cisplatin chemotherapy treatment.

supplements.title: Rabdosin B suppresses proliferation of nonsmall cell lung cancer by regulating the SRC/PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Rabdosin B, a compound from a Chinese herb, stops lung cancer cell growth by blocking a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Low, plasma level‑informed native curcumin concentrations fail to induce cell death in human lung and colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Curcumin from turmeric at realistic blood levels fails to kill lung and colorectal cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into the roles of astragalosides and Astragalus polysaccharides in gynecological and breast cancers (Review).
supplements.summary: Astragalus compounds show promise as adjuvant therapy for breast, ovarian, and cervical cancers by suppressing tumor growth and enhancing immune response.

supplements.title: Lifelong vitamin B12 monitoring after gastrectomy: A case report of subacute combined degeneration with 8-year latency in an alcoholic.
supplements.summary: Doctors should monitor vitamin B12 levels for life after stomach removal surgery, especially in patients who drink alcohol heavily.

supplements.title: Integrative network pharmacology and in vitro validation reveal the mechanisms by which Apigenin reverses MET-TKI resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
supplements.summary: Apigenin helps overcome drug resistance in lung cancer by reversing resistance to MET-targeted therapies.

supplements.title: Enhanced antitumor activity of atorvastatin and luteolin, with or without doxorubicin, in a solid Ehrlich carcinoma mouse model: modulation of ABC transporters, telomerase, and cancer stem cells.
supplements.summary: Atorvastatin and luteolin combination therapy effectively reduced solid Ehrlich carcinoma tumors by targeting chemoresistance mechanisms.

supplements.title: Exploring the role of metabolic disorders and gut microbiome in immune checkpoint regulation in cancer: PI3K/AKT/mTOR focus.
supplements.summary: Metabolic disorders and unhealthy gut bacteria weaken immune defenses against cancer by suppressing anti-tumor immunity through inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: Trigonelline suppresses the tumor progression via STAT2 signalling pathway in non-Small cell lung carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Trigonelline, a natural compound, kills lung cancer cells by blocking growth and triggering cell death through the STAT2 pathway.

supplements.title: Effectiveness of exercise interventions in patients with colorectal cancer during adjuvant chemotherapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise during chemotherapy helps colorectal cancer patients maintain physical function and quality of life better than standard care alone.

supplements.title: Pedunculoside Inhibits Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression by Activating the MAPK Signaling Pathway Through Targeting and Suppressing CDK4.
supplements.summary: Pedunculoside, a natural compound, slows liver cancer by blocking CDK4 protein, stopping cancer cell growth and triggering cell death.

supplements.title: Engineered E. coli Nissle 1917 Depletes Branched-Chain Amino Acids to Suppress Colorectal Tumorigenesis.
supplements.summary: Engineered bacteria that deplete branched-chain amino acids in the gut significantly suppress colorectal cancer growth in mice.

supplements.title: Gracillin overcomes osimertinib resistance in NSCLC via dual inhibition of EGFR and Mcl-1.
supplements.summary: Gracillin, a natural product, overcomes osimertinib resistance in lung cancer by targeting EGFR and destroying cancer-protecting Mcl-1 protein.

off_label.title: From Biomarker to Drug Target: Integrating ceRNA Networks and Pharmacogenomics to Reposition C5orf34 in Uterine Corpus Endometrial Cancer Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified C5orf34 as a potential new drug target for uterine cancer that could improve patient outcomes and treatment options.

off_label.title: Enhanced antitumor activity of atorvastatin and luteolin, with or without doxorubicin, in a solid Ehrlich carcinoma mouse model: modulation of ABC transporters, telomerase, and cancer stem cells.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin and luteolin combination therapy effectively reduced solid Ehrlich carcinoma tumors by targeting chemoresistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Second-generation prokineticin PKR1 receptor agonists: Advancing cardioprotection against chemotherapy-induced toxicity.
off_label.summary: A new drug called IS39 protects the heart from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy in cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Alterations in the testicular lipidome after tumor irradiation and their potential modulation by long-term losartan treatment.
off_label.summary: Losartan treatment may help protect testicular function and fertility in cancer patients receiving radiation therapy by reducing radiation-induced lipid damage.

off_label.title: Endoscopic application of tranexamic acid and sucralfate in upper gastrointestinal bleeding: A randomized controlled trial.
off_label.summary: Applying tranexamic acid and sucralfate directly to bleeding sites during endoscopy reduces rebleeding in difficult upper gastrointestinal cases.

off_label.title: Ultrasound-Responsive Dual-Prodrug Nanoassembly for 'Fenestrae-Restoration Strategy' in Liver Fibrosis Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed ultrasound-activated nanoparticles that restore liver blood vessel openings, allowing anti-fibrosis drugs to reach and stop liver scarring progression.

off_label.title: Targeting WIP1 reprograms immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment to potentiate immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking WIP1 protein in colorectal cancer reactivates immune cells and improves immunotherapy effectiveness when combined with STING activation.

off_label.title: Overcoming vascular niche-mediated TKI resistance in acute myeloid leukemia through miR-126 inhibition.
off_label.summary: Blocking miR-126 in leukemia cells combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors overcomes drug resistance and prevents AML relapse.

off_label.title: Histone lactylation-driven feedback loop modulates pyrimidine metabolism to promote oral carcinogenesis.
off_label.summary: Blocking lactate-driven histone modifications in oral cancer cells reduces tumor growth by disrupting a metabolic feedback loop.

off_label.title: SGLT2 inhibitors mitigate cardiorenal toxicity and improve survival in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients undergoing antineoplastic therapy: A multicenter retrospective cohort study.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced heart disease by 86% and death by 85% in diabetic cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis Induction by Fenbendazole Combined With Photothermal Therapy Triggers Dual-Immunotherapy Against Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining a drug with heat therapy triggers immune-boosting cell death in bladder cancer tumors.

off_label.title: EZH2 inhibition in resistant glioblastoma stem cells counteracts oxidative stress protection and triggers ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: EZH2 inhibition triggers ferroptosis in drug-resistant glioblastoma stem cells, overcoming their oxidative stress protection and inducing cell death.

off_label.title: Rituximab limits glucocorticoid use in IgG4-related disease: Real-world evidence from a large European cohort.
off_label.summary: Rituximab helps patients with IgG4-related disease reduce their dependence on glucocorticoid medications, based on real-world European patient data.

off_label.title: Enzalutamide Plus Metformin Versus Enzalutamide Alone in Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer: A Randomized Phase 2 Trial (SAKK 08/14).
off_label.summary: Adding metformin to enzalutamide improves outcomes in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

off_label.title: Downregulation of TDP43 by atovaquone inhibits oxidative phosphorylation and enhances sensitivity of triple-negative breast cancer to EGFR-TKIs.
off_label.summary: Drug atovaquone inhibits a protein called TDP43, reducing energy production in triple-negative breast cancer cells and improving their response to EGFR inhibitors.

biomarkers.title: Endobronchial Ultrasound-guided Transbronchial Needle Aspiration Detection of PET-CT Negative Contralateral Hilar Lymph Node Metastasis in the Staging of Non-small cell Lung Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A minimally invasive ultrasound procedure successfully detected lung cancer spread to lymph nodes that standard imaging missed.

biomarkers.title: CCAAT-enhancer binding protein delta functions as a tumor suppressor gene in acute myeloid leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: CEBPD protein acts as a tumor suppressor in acute myeloid leukemia, with its loss promoting cancer growth through increased signaling.

biomarkers.title: Liver Histiocytosis Masquerading as Hepatic Dysfunction: Rare Case Story.
biomarkers.summary: Rare Langerhans cell histiocytosis caused liver dysfunction in an adult patient; hepatoprotective treatment improved liver function and symptoms.

biomarkers.title: The Wnt receptor Frizzled3 (FZD3) drives aggressive phenotypes in small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A protein called Frizzled3 drives aggressive growth in small cell lung cancer, suggesting a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Retlirafusp Alfa: First Approval.
biomarkers.summary: New drug retlirafusp alfa approved for advanced gastric cancer when combined with chemotherapy in patients with specific immune markers.

biomarkers.title: Clinical characteristics of autoimmune GFAP astrocytopathy with concomitant Epstein-Barr virus positivity: a case series of 12 patients and literature review.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a rare brain disorder where autoimmune inflammation and Epstein-Barr virus infection occur together, expanding understanding of this condition.

biomarkers.title: Oncogenic GPRIN1 sustains proliferation and mitochondrial homeostasis via dual‑layer CDK1-PI3K/Akt signalling in gallbladder cancer.
biomarkers.summary: GPRIN1 drives gallbladder cancer growth by controlling cell cycle and mitochondrial health through a dual regulatory pathway, offering a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: CD8+ T Cell Infiltration Elicits Molecular Subtype-Biased Clinical Outcomes in Gastric Cancer Patients.
biomarkers.summary: CD8+ T cell infiltration predicts better survival in some gastric cancer subtypes, but low infiltration indicates chemotherapy benefit in others.

biomarkers.title: Coronavirus disease 2019 infection reduces EGFR-TKI efficacy in non-small cell lung carcinoma: Real-world evidence from a multicenter propensity-matched cohort.
biomarkers.summary: COVID-19 infection significantly reduces the effectiveness of EGFR-targeted drugs in advanced lung cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: Novel genomic risk stratification model for primary high-grade malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST).
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a genomic risk model for nerve sheath tumors that predicts survival better than traditional clinical factors alone.

biomarkers.title: DS96432529 enhances osteogenic differentiation and mitigates inflammatory damage in periodontal ligament stem cells involving mitophagy-related processes.
biomarkers.summary: A synthetic molecule called DS96432529 improves bone-forming cells' ability to regenerate periodontal tissue by reducing inflammation.

biomarkers.title: Deciphering lung adenocarcinoma heterogeneity: a multi-omics approach reveals nuclear division fibroblasts as prognosticators and therapeutic targets.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a specific type of lung fibroblast linked to lung cancer survival and potential new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Prospective Study of Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab for Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma Based on Hepatobiliary Phase of Gd-EOB-DTPA-MRI.
biomarkers.summary: MRI imaging patterns predict which hepatocellular carcinoma patients will benefit from combination immunotherapy treatment.

biomarkers.title: Real-World Outcomes of Sequential Afatinib and Osimertinib Versus Afatinib and Chemotherapy in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC: Taiwan Multicenter GIANT Study.
biomarkers.summary: Sequential use of two targeted drugs works as well as combining a targeted drug with chemotherapy for EGFR-mutant lung cancer.

biomarkers.title: DGAT1 mediates sex-specific CD8+ T cell antitumour responses.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking DGAT1 in female mice boosts cancer-fighting T cells, while males require this protein to survive hormone-related stress.

trials.title: Endobronchial Ultrasound-guided Transbronchial Needle Aspiration Detection of PET-CT Negative Contralateral Hilar Lymph Node Metastasis in the Staging of Non-small cell Lung Cancer.
trials.summary: A minimally invasive ultrasound procedure successfully detected lung cancer spread to lymph nodes that standard imaging missed.

trials.title: Histology-guided spatial lipidomics and proteomics of the trisynaptic circuit in the human hippocampus.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new imaging method to map lipids and proteins in different hippocampus regions, revealing distinct molecular patterns important for memory and learning.

trials.title: Retlirafusp Alfa: First Approval.
trials.summary: New drug retlirafusp alfa approved for advanced gastric cancer when combined with chemotherapy in patients with specific immune markers.

trials.title: CD8+ T Cell Infiltration Elicits Molecular Subtype-Biased Clinical Outcomes in Gastric Cancer Patients.
trials.summary: CD8+ T cell infiltration predicts better survival in some gastric cancer subtypes, but low infiltration indicates chemotherapy benefit in others.

trials.title: Coronavirus disease 2019 infection reduces EGFR-TKI efficacy in non-small cell lung carcinoma: Real-world evidence from a multicenter propensity-matched cohort.
trials.summary: COVID-19 infection significantly reduces the effectiveness of EGFR-targeted drugs in advanced lung cancer patients.

trials.title: Prospective Study of Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab for Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma Based on Hepatobiliary Phase of Gd-EOB-DTPA-MRI.
trials.summary: MRI imaging patterns predict which hepatocellular carcinoma patients will benefit from combination immunotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Health-related quality of life in breast cancer measured with EQ-5D-5L.
trials.summary: Researchers measured breast cancer patients' quality of life using EQ-5D-5L to assess health utility values for cost-effectiveness analyses.

trials.title: Real-World Outcomes of Sequential Afatinib and Osimertinib Versus Afatinib and Chemotherapy in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC: Taiwan Multicenter GIANT Study.
trials.summary: Sequential use of two targeted drugs works as well as combining a targeted drug with chemotherapy for EGFR-mutant lung cancer.

trials.title: Real-world clinical utility of tumor whole-genome sequencing in solid cancers.
trials.summary: Whole-genome sequencing identified actionable treatment biomarkers in 73% of solid cancer patients, with biomarker-guided therapy extending survival by 96 days.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant immunochemoradiotherapy with nivolumab, paclitaxel, and cisplatin followed by esophagectomy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
trials.summary: A combination of immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and radiation before surgery shows promise for treating advanced esophageal cancer.

trials.title: Dalpiciclib plus chidamide in HR + /HER2-advanced breast cancer after CDK4/6 inhibitor failure: a phase Ib trial.
trials.summary: Dalpiciclib plus chidamide shows manageable safety and preliminary antitumor activity in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer resistant to prior CDK4/6 inhibitors.

trials.title: Fatty acid oxidation drives acetyl-CoA-dependent H3K9ac reprogramming to promote adaptive resistance to BRAFV600E inhibition in thyroid cancer.
trials.summary: Thyroid cancer cells resist BRAF inhibitor drugs by burning more fatty acids, which cancer researchers can block to improve treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Efficacy of stem cell boost (SCB) for chimeric antigen receptor-T cell therapy (CAR-T)-related hematologic toxicity in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM)-real world experience from the US multiple myeloma immunotherapy consortium.
trials.summary: Stem cell boost rapidly restores blood cell counts in multiple myeloma patients experiencing severe side effects from CAR-T cell therapy.

trials.title: Fixed-Duration Subcutaneous Mosunetuzumab in Relapsed/Refractory Follicular Lymphoma: Pivotal Phase 2 Primary Analysis.
trials.summary: Subcutaneous mosunetuzumab injection works as well as IV infusion for relapsed follicular lymphoma, with faster administration and fewer side effects.

trials.title: Outcomes of the first national oral cancer screening programme in Taiwan, 2004-2022: a population-based study.
trials.summary: Taiwan's national oral cancer screening program reduced late-stage cases and deaths among screened populations from 2004-2022.
